name: aic/app
description: Absolute Insanity, AI (AIAI): the demo app that runs aic/framework.

scripts-descriptions.build: Write the build-time outputs: the generated wiring, build/surface.json, each component template's class, and public/assets/ (the modules' CSS and the theme in aic.css, the modules' other assets copied).
scripts-descriptions.gate: Run every quality gate and print one gate-summary line (bin/gate-runner.sh).
scripts-descriptions.gate:0: composer audit: no known security advisories in the locked dependencies.
scripts-descriptions.gate:1: composer-normalize: the root and framework manifests are in canonical order.
scripts-descriptions.gate:10: PHPMD: every ruleset, at the limits in phpmd.xml.
scripts-descriptions.gate:12: Deptrac: the layer ladder inside each system.
scripts-descriptions.gate:15: semgrep: the AIC ruleset in semgrep.yml.
scripts-descriptions.gate:16: No runtime-dynamic require or include in runtime code.
scripts-descriptions.gate:17: gitleaks: no secrets in the history.
scripts-descriptions.gate:18: shellcheck: every shell script, at warning level.
scripts-descriptions.gate:19: Documentation: no TODO markers, no dead relative links.
scripts-descriptions.gate:2: Runtime require allow-list: php, ext-*, psr/* and aic/framework only.
scripts-descriptions.gate:20: captainhook: the git hooks are installed.
scripts-descriptions.gate:21: Native: every runtime class compiles, links, runs and matches PHP under elephc.
scripts-descriptions.gate:22: Pipeline docs: frontmatter, line caps and internal links of the pipeline docs and phase commands.
scripts-descriptions.gate:23: Native site: the app compiled with elephc --web answers every step as the interpreted app does.
scripts-descriptions.gate:24: Build outputs: the generated wiring, build/surface.json, the template classes and public/assets/ match what composer run build writes; an orphan there is stale.
scripts-descriptions.gate:25: Templates: every component template (*.html.php) uses only the plain PHP template grammar; deny by default.
scripts-descriptions.gate:26: Module boundaries: kind folders, the 15-file cap, exports and requires, no require cycles, nothing outside modules/ but the shell.
scripts-descriptions.gate:27: RawHtml, counted: every use listed and held to its grant in config/raw-html.php; RawHtml:: only in the Renderer.
scripts-descriptions.gate:3: Require-checker: every symbol the runtime code uses comes from a declared require.
scripts-descriptions.gate:4: composer-unused: no required package goes unused.
scripts-descriptions.gate:7: Rector: no pending PHP 8.5 refactors (dry run).
scripts-descriptions.gate:8: PHPStan level 10, bleeding edge, with the strict rule sets.
scripts-descriptions.gate:9: phpat: the architecture rules in gates/architecture.
scripts-descriptions.native:serve: Build the compiled site and serve it on 127.0.0.1:8090 (or the given port) until interrupted.
